title: Extract and validate JSON
hints: extract_json: start, end = text.find("{"), text.rfind("}"). Taking that slice also handles a code fence and surrounding sentences. Turn json.JSONDecodeError into ValueError.
validate: types = expected if isinstance(expected, tuple) else (expected,). When float is among them, add int. Test for bool first, because True is an int in Python.
ask_json: loop `attempts` times. In the except ValueError branch, extend messages with the assistant's text and the user's correction request.
